brief.claim: The treatment raises invertebrate abundance in the field plots: abundance is higher in treated plots than in control plots, and a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test comparing the abundances of the two groups gives p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: number of individuals counted in a sample from each plot on each weekly sampling date, dates in order
whether the plot received the treatment

brief.sizes: plots = 12; dates = 12 (abundance: 12 x 12 = 144 values; treated: 12 values)
